topic: Introduction to turbine engine starting: Basic circuit of turbo prop engine starting system, turbo starter system, and starter generator system
syllabus_extract: Introduction to turbine engine starting: - Basic circuit of turbo prop engine starting system, turbo starter system, and starter generator system. Safeties to be taken while gas turbine engine starting. Practical on engine starting system.
specific_objectives: 13.1.3.1 Knowledge on circuit protection devices, generators, actuators & engine starting system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Demonstration of engine starting system circuit verification, safety check of starter generator isolation, and verification of circuit protection devices.
intro_questions: What are the three main components of a turbo prop starting system?
Name one circuit protection device used in engine starting circuits.
Why is the starter generator used during the starting phase?
